annotations.title: Government debt and deficit in the EU

description: Use for government debt and deficit of EU countries and Poland against the EU, and for the 3% and 60% of GDP reference values. For Polish State Treasury debt per month, use get_public_debt. General government gross debt, deficit and interest as % of GDP in the 27 EU countries, the EU and the euro area (Eurostat): debt at the end of the latest quarter with the change in a year, deficit, interest and debt in the latest year from the excessive deficit procedure notification, ranks, countries above the 3% deficit and 60% debt reference values in the data (not the list of countries under the procedure), annual history of Poland, the EU and one comparison country, and finwire_eu_debt_threshold_gap (Poland quarterly debt minus 60, percentage points).

compare.description: EU country code (Eurostat, Greece = EL) for the history and the comparison with Poland, default DE.
